notes.title: Second Anniversary Event
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40817842/2baaa9b8927b45f27deec1478d8f7bd12b1650ba.png[/img]

Purgo box will celebrate the second anniversary of its release on Steam on July 14.
So I have prepared a small event for you!
From today until 7/22, we will place an event that allows free access to the MAP, which is difficult to access outside the white room.
To use it, select the X-axis, Y-axis and MAP ID of the destination and touch the crystal.
Thanks to all players who played.

notes.title: first anniversary!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40817842/0d3dde66505972f9574f9fb59d52c931528cf585.png[/img].
On July 14, it will have been one year since we released this on Steam.
Therefore, we will distribute this lame first anniversary hat.
On 7/14, I will appear between 18:00 and 24:00 JST, and you can get this hat by approaching me.
At this time, those who can use the identity change box can already obtain it.
Thanks for the first anniversary!
